svg.text: Replacement hood safety catch, 5 mm steel plate (all dimensions mm, scale 6:1)
Origin: pivot axis (M6 shoulder bolt, axis square to the hood skin, plate mid-thickness 6 mm below the hood's underside). F: towards the front edge. R: towards the robot's right.
Top view (looking down through the hood)
striker bar (8 mm round, along R) over the lip, F = -6
Side view (from the robot's right; D = down from the plate mid-plane)
Lever: 52 mm bar from 3 mm behind the pivot to the tab; tab centre 46 mm forward of the pivot (1.4 cm behind the hood's front edge).
Arm: 36 mm to the robot's right; post (8 x 8, 30 mm down) centred 30 mm right of the pivot; lip 14 mm long pointing rearward at its foot.
Lip top 26 mm below the plate mid-plane; the striker bar sits 0.5 mm above it, its centre 6 mm rear of the post centre.
Return spring: torsion spring about the pivot, 0.004 N m per deg, preloaded 3 deg against a rest stop pin; second stop pin at 30 deg.
Pushing the tab 15 mm towards the robot's left (19.5 deg) swings the lip clear of the bar. Mass about 120 g.
